details: Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced slight declines as investors reacted to lingering geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and the U.S. Federal Reserve's hawkish stance on interest rates. While the Fed kept rates unchanged, some committee members favored a hike, sending a cautious signal. Despite a rally in AI-linked technology stocks, crypto assets largely did not participate in the broader risk-on move. Bitcoin traded below $64,000, and Ethereum also saw minor dips, reflecting investor caution and macroeconomic uncertainty.
title: Middle East Tensions & Hawkish Fed Weigh on Crypto

details: A Reuters investigation revealed that an illicit Iranian gambling network moved at least $4 billion through Shelbit, an unlicensed Dubai-based cryptocurrency exchange. The exchange also reportedly handled funds for sanctioned Iranian institutions and interacted with Iran's central bank and wallets linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority has ordered Shelbit to halt all unlicensed activity due to concerns over money laundering and terrorism financing.
title: Illicit Iranian Gambling Network Uses Dubai Crypto Exchange
